Topic 5: How the Bundle Works: A Real-World Scenario The Situation: Aarav's dog, Leo, requires an emergency surgery with a vet estimate of ₹80,000. He is approved by Akash Ganga Bank at the reduced interest rate of 10.5%. The bank pays the ₹80,000 directly to the vet. The Suraksha Sahayata system auto-files the claim with Suraksha Bima. Suraksha Bima processes the claim. After the ₹5,000 deductible, they reimburse 85% of the remaining ₹75,000, which equals ₹63,750. This reimbursement is paid directly towards Aarav's loan balance. Aarav's final outstanding loan amount is only ₹16,250 (₹80,000 - ₹63,750), which he can pay in easy EMIs.
